cases.rationale: Several actual people, including the seated foreground rider and background riders, are visible. The prominent horses are molded carousel figures, so they do not satisfy actual horse presence; carousel saddles are not identifiable chairs. I considered every frozen definition across the whole crop. No other listed object is identifiable, and there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

An actual baseball batter is clearly visible. The hand coverings are batting gloves, not a baseball fielding mitt; the bat and ball do not belong to these 75 categories. The background contains field, track and railing rather than identifiable listed objects. I considered all 75 definitions and have no unresolved category ambiguity.

The airborne rider is an actual person with both feet attached to a single broad snowboard, whose deck and bindings are identifiable. The red slope marker is a flag rather than a flying kite. Trees and snow do not establish any other category. All 75 definitions were considered; no category ambiguity remains.

The crop shows snowy terrain and trees, with a short black rounded snow-equipment tip entering at the bottom. Its limited visible width and detail leave ski versus snowboard unresolved, so snowboard is unclear. No actual human body part is identifiable merely from this viewpoint. I explicitly considered all 75 definitions; no other listed category has supporting visible evidence.

A plaid-covered bed with pillows, a tan backpack with pack body and straps, a rigid teal travel suitcase in the foreground, part of a wooden chair at the left edge, and numerous bound books on shelves and in stacks are visible. The rear surface is a study/work desk, not an identifiable dining table. Small upright shelf containers lack enough detail to distinguish bottles and drinking cups confidently, leaving bottle and cup unclear. The small rectangular shelf device is not an identifiable clock. I considered every one of the 75 definitions, with no additional unresolved category identities.

Actual people and beach chairs are visible on the right and nearer the water, beneath an identifiable pole-supported beach umbrella. A distant ship silhouette with hull and raised structure is visible on the horizon. The small legged object left of the central people is too indistinct to establish whether it is an eating table, so dining table remains unclear. Sand, ocean and the distant shoreline supply no other identifiable listed object. All 75 definitions were explicitly considered.

The discarded mattress is identifiable bedding in bed context, and a single-person chair with back and legs enters the lower right. A tiny upright yellow-green container beside the mattress may be a bottle, but its neck and body are insufficiently resolved, so bottle is unclear. The damaged white box at left is not identifiable as a refrigerator, sink or other listed appliance; weeds growing through the pavement are not potted plants. All 75 definitions were considered.

Several actual soccer players or their body parts are visible on grass. The gold soccer ball is outside the 75 supplied categories, and clothing and shoes are not evidence of bags or other equipment. I considered all 75 definitions over the entire crop; no other listed object or unresolved category ambiguity is visible.

The kitchen contains a range with an oven door, a cropped microwave at left above a small refrigerator, and a sink with faucet at right. Wooden dining chairs and the corner of their wooden eating table are visible in the foreground. Small countertop vessels beside the coffee maker and dish rack are insufficiently resolved to distinguish drinking cups and bottles from jars or other containers, so cup and bottle remain unclear. The kettle and coffee carafe are not themselves proof of cups, and plates in the rack are not bowls. All 75 frozen definitions were considered.

An actual woolly sheep with a black-and-white face and curled horn lies beside fencing. Actual birds include the distinctive pheasant at lower left and a small dark bird on the grass. The shallow metal feeding trough is not an identifiable bowl or sink. After considering all 75 definitions, no other listed object or unresolved category ambiguity is present.

Two actual children hold tennis rackets with clear strung heads and handles on a tennis court. The court net, ball, fence and hats do not satisfy other supplied definitions. I considered all 75 categories across the crop and found no additional identifiable category or unresolved category ambiguity.

The batter and the partially cropped catcher are actual people. At the right edge the catcher wears a yellow-brown baseball fielding mitt with its open pocket visible, which satisfies baseball glove; the batter's small hand gloves alone would not. The bat and baseball-field markings are outside the supplied categories. All 75 definitions were considered, with no unresolved category ambiguity.
